chunks: Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from al-Ḥalabī, said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who had intercourse with his mukātabah. He said: “If she has paid one-quarter, he is to be flogged; and if he is muḥṣan, he is to be stoned. But if she has not paid anything, then there is nothing upon him.”

key_terms.أَدَّتِ الرُّبُعَ: she has paid one-quarter of the contractual amount
key_terms.جُلِدَ: he is to be flogged as a legal punishment
key_terms.فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ: there is no legal penalty upon him
key_terms.مُحْصَنًا: legally married or otherwise in the state of iḥṣān
key_terms.مُكَاتَبَتِهِ: his slave-woman under a manumission contract

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man has intercourse with his mukātabah according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who has intercourse with his mukātabah slave-woman. The ruling distinguishes between whether she has paid part of her contractual emancipation and whether the man is muḥṣan, showing graded legal consequences in the law of zinā.
